pages.text: At its $(thing)eutectic$() an alloy melts all at once: the $(item)Phase Diagram Kiln$() makes Superconducting Solder from lead and copper more cheaply. The $(item)Doping Furnace$() diffuses a dopant into a wafer for a working junction (10¹⁶ to 10¹⁸ carriers); a $(item)Doped Wafer$() goes through the Lithographer at twice the yield.
The $(item)Sintering Press$() fires alumina dense without growing its grains: $(item)Alumina Ceramic Plates$(), and with aramid behind them, $(item)Ceramic Armour Plates$().
